overview: Open-top variant of the SF90 XX Stradale; revealed June 2023, limited to 599 units (allocations sold out). Same 1,030 hp combined PHEV powertrain. Carbon-bodied retractable hardtop and fixed rear wing retained. Final production year MY2025. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferrari_SF90_Stradale, https://www.hagerty.com/valuation-tools/ferrari/sf90_xx_spider/2025/2025-ferrari-sf90_xx_spider
